source_schedule: deterministic source SHA256 order, alternating Train/Val; no selection based on observed IoU
frame_sampling: six disjoint temporal strata, alternating within-source GT scale targets
evaluation_split: independent val excluding known P1 training byte aliases
bootstrap_unit: independent source within each dataset and route

visual_probe.features: geometry only vs geometry plus eight label-blind low-level RGB descriptors

smoke_test: reuse already passed actual Video-ORA A/B evidence, no repeat
followup: CPU analyses only, then stop; no next GPU job
license_review: project owner confirmed complete; no agent re-review
interval_scope: conditional on partial observed cohort; historical Val is not a fresh never-exposed test
previews: operational CPU correctness checks only; no Val tuning of constants, bins or ridge alpha
